_doc: Client accent themes. Every semantic token that points at the default accent scale (cloud blue) is emitted as var(--accent-N), so a client accent swaps the whole intent/action layer. <html data-accent="<id>"> switches. on-accent (text/icons on accent-9) is chosen at build time: white if it reaches 4.5:1, otherwise mauve 13.

waive.why: ruby 9 reaches only 4.19:1 with white and less with mauve 13 – open design decision (use step 10/11 for solid buttons?)
